}}'''Yasicca Cellaech''' was an ancient scholar and an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Cellaech, Yasicca}}

== History ==
{{quote|So long as we do not depend on the facts entirely, incomplete knowledge is better than complete ignorance.}} [[Egwene al'Vere]] says this sentence to [[Saerin Asnobar]], who recognizes it as a quote from Yasicca.{{ref/book|13|15}}

== Trivia ==
* Yasicca Cellaech is named for Jessica Celuch, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
